Subtracting. So 176 minus 137... is it 39? Just tell me yes or no so I can submit!

Since this is for a quiz, I can't confirm if your final result is correct. However, your logic of subtracting the picked tomatoes from the total is the right way to approach this. I encourage you to double-check your subtraction one more time to be sure!
